cases.title: Configure TVM Coin Vault Threshhold
cases.section_path: TVM / Deploy the Software, Configurations & Topology
cases.custom_steps:
The coin bin or coin box contains in the TVM has 2 threshold parameters can be set in TMS to enable event notifications to be generated for Translink when Coins fall below the set thresholds.  This setting is to ensure the correct events are raised for Translink who can then send an engineer to perform a collection of the coins so it can then be used again.

Coin box function:
Coin box/bin contains any coins which cannot be recycled by the hoppers.  The TVM recycles the coins which it can back into the hopper and any coins which cannot are then sent to the coin bin/box.  When it approaches max capacity (configurable in TMS- this test) it will generate the appropriate event alert to the BOS.
- Coin vault almost full - left 'Threshold weight' - event code 1030
- Coin vault full - right Threshold weight'- event code 1031

cases.section_path: TVM / Other
cases.custom_steps:
This test verifies that the TVM allows refilling of the hoppers by method of physical replacement of the hoppers then manually adjust the levels.

________________________________________________

 This tests the functionality of how engineers complete a replacement of coins replenishment.  This is normally part of the cash collection/replenishment process.  In live the hoppers are pre-filled and swapped with the existing hoppers.  For test purposes we will take a snapshot of the existing hopper levels then adjust the accordingly

cases.title: Replenish Coin Levels - EMS Manually Refilling of Hoppers
cases.section_path: TVM / Other
cases.custom_steps: This test verifies that when the TVM is in a 'Low change' state then the coin-stock can be replenished by inserting coins individually via the EMS 'Refilling hoppers' option in Maintenance of Coin system.  This test also ensures that older issue coins go to the Coin bin

cases.title: Replenish Coin Levels - Coins Before 2011
cases.section_path: TVM / Other
cases.custom_steps:
There are 5 hoppers within the TVMs where the assigned coins can be replenished when customers use change to buy tickets.  The following coin denominations are recycled: 5p, 10p, 50p, £1 £2.  **If the coins were issued before 2011 then they are NOT recycled** and are instead sent to the coin bin (you will hear a drop).

- Positive test: Gather coins which are recycled and use them to buy tickets using the exact change.  
- Negative test 1: Gather coins which were issued BEFORE 2011  and use them to buy tickets using the exact change.  
- Negative test 2: Buy a product using 20ps' only

cases.title: Green state - Purchase until Low change state
cases.section_path: TVM / Other
cases.custom_steps:
1. This test will prove that when a TVM has change available then it give change to customers until it reaches a 'low change state'.  
2. This test will then prove that when it is 'low change' state then customers can still buy tickets but only when the exact change is used until the coins threshold limits are exceeded resulting in the TVM to giving change again. 

- Keep hold of tickets and record how much was paid with
- Verify by printing cash content report in EMS at step 3
- CF event code hoppers nearly empty when the limits of coin hit thresholds and respective clear event is raised when low change is remedied with customers inserting coins to fill hoppers

- Add product for a smartcard, Multi-journey, Travelcard or yLink
- Collect a pre-booked ticket 
- Buy additional products by using the **basket function**
- Buy a ticket using an overpayment with a high value note and select the change voucher option
- Increasing a quantity and pressing **back** then selecting a different product to add to basket

**THEN** the payment is accepted
**AND** the transaction completes successfully for the correct amount

cases.title: Contactless - Remove Payment Card Before Transaction Completes - Cancel or Retry
cases.section_path: EMV PAYMENTS / Edge Case Tests / EMV Payment - Payment Does Not Complete / CONTACTLESS CARD Payment Does Not Complete
cases.custom_steps:
Verfiies the response of the TVM following the user removing their *Contactless* payment card before payment has completed.

**GIVEN** a transaction has been selected
**AND** the user has opted to pay by EMV
**WHEN** the user presents their *Contactless* payment card
**AND** IMMEDIATELY removes the card before payment is complete
**THEN** the transaction is not complete
**AND** Payment is not debited from the users card

___________________________________
Web MIS - transaction status'

- Approved - successful payment 
- Voided transaction is a transaction that has been marked as cancelled. We will never ask the bank to settle such a transaction
- Uncommitted transaction is a transaction that has not been marked for settlement. The funds have been reserved against the card, however until it is marked as committed we will not ask the bank to settle the transaction.

cases.title: Device Lockout  - TVM goes Out of Service when a BOS communication has not occurred after configured time
cases.section_path: DEVICE LOCKOUT / TVM states after Comms related issues
cases.custom_steps:
Verifies the Sales App locks out the TVM when communications with the BOS has not occurred after the configured time.

**GIVEN** the TVM is configured to lockout with no communication
**WHEN** the lockout time is met without communication with the BOS
**THEN** the SalesApp changes state to "Out Of Service"
**AND** the TVM can no longer be used

cases.title: Device Lockout - TVM does NOT go Out of Service when the TVM establishes a connection with the BOS seconds before the configured "non-communication lockout limit"
cases.section_path: DEVICE LOCKOUT / TVM states after Comms related issues
cases.custom_steps:
Verifies the TVM does not go Out of Service if a successful BOS communications session is established before the expiration of the configured non-communication time limit.

**GIVEN** the TVM is configured to lockout with no communication
**AND** the TVM has not communicated with the BOS but the limit is not yet met
**WHEN** the TVM established a connection seconds before the limit
**THEN** the TVM Remains in service

cases.title: Device Lockout - TVM does not remain Out of Service when the TVM re-establishes communication with the BOS after it has gone out of Service after meeting the configured "non-communication lockout limit"
cases.section_path: DEVICE LOCKOUT / TVM states after Comms related issues
cases.custom_steps:
Verifies the TVM does not go out service if it re-establishes communication with the BOS after having gone out of Service after meeting the configured "non-communication lockout limit"

**GIVEN** the TVM is out of service due to lack of communication
**WHEN** the TVM re-establishes communication with the BOS
**THEN** the TVM changes state back In Service

cases.title: Glider - 1 x Adult Single - Paid using coins - Audit data sent to CloudFare
cases.section_path: OTHER / Audit Data sent to Cloudfare
cases.custom_steps:
* **Given** that a passenger is presented with a working **Ticket Vending Machine**,
* **When** that passenger selects a **single Adult Fare** to a destination,
